T: No backup, no extraction, no leftovers.
D: When a bombing at the Kremlin is pinned on the IMF, Ethan and a small cut-off team chase a nuclear extremist from Moscow to Dubai to Mumbai.
P: Serve the pirozhki when Ethan breaks out of the Moscow prison with Bogdan.
S: Warm from a Moscow street stall after the prison break.
Soft yeasted buns stuffed with buttery braised cabbage, onion, egg and dill, brushed with egg and baked golden.
Train carriage herring on black bread
Pickled herring on buttered rye with red onion and dill, a cold bite for the siding.
Butter 8 slices of dark rye bread and cut each in half. Lay a piece of pickled herring on each with thin red onion rings and dill. Grind over black pepper and serve cold.
M: Kremlin chicken Kiev with buttered peas
Crumbed chicken breast round a core of garlic butter, with buttered peas, cut at the table.

Mash 100g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves and chopped parsley, roll into a log and freeze 20 minutes. Butterfly 4 chicken breasts, pound thin, wrap each round a quarter of the butter and chill. Dip in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs twice, fry until golden then bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Serve with buttered peas.
Mushrooms in paprika sour cream over egg noodles, for Benji and Ethan walking into the Kremlin.

Mixed mushrooms in a paprika and sour cream sauce over buttered egg noodles with dill pickles. Brown the sliced mushrooms in half the butter in batches and lift out. Fry the sliced onion and garlic in the rest of the butter for 5 minutes, then stir in the paprika and flour. Add the stock and mustard, put the mushrooms back and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in the sour cream off the heat. Cook the noodles, drain and toss with a little butter. Serve over the noodles with dill and pickles on the side.
W: Siding syrniki with sour cream and jam
Golden cottage cheese pancakes with sour cream and cherry jam, still warm from the pan.

Mix 500g cottage cheese with 2 eggs, 3 tbsp sugar, a pinch of salt and 100g plain flour. Shape into 12 small thick rounds in more flour. Fry in butter over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Serve warm with sour cream and cherry jam.
K: Samovar tea with lemon and jam
Strong black tea poured hot over lemon, a spoon of jam on the side to stir in.

Brew 4 tsp strong black tea leaves in 1 litre of boiling water for 4 minutes and strain. Pour into glasses with a slice of lemon in each, and serve with sugar cubes and a little dish of cherry jam to stir in.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead; the baked buns keep 1 day airtight and reheat well, or freeze them for a month

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and 1 tsp of the salt with the warm milk, melted butter and egg for the dough, and knead until smooth.
Cover and prove until doubled. Meanwhile boil the eggs for the filling for 9 minutes, and cook the cabbage and onion slowly in the butter until soft and sweet.
Season the cabbage with the rest of the salt and the pepper, cool a little, then mix in the chopped eggs and dill.
Divide the dough into 16, flatten each piece, fill, pinch closed and set seam side down on lined trays.
Rest the buns while the oven heats to 200C.
Brush with the beaten egg and bake until golden.

s.note: Soft baked buns filled with buttery cabbage, onion, egg and dill.
s.how: Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tbsp caster sugar and 1 tsp salt with 250ml warm milk, 60g melted butter and 1 egg, and knead for 10 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove for an hour until doubled. Meanwhile boil 2 eggs for 9 minutes, and cook 500g finely shredded white cabbage and 1 diced onion slowly in 40g butter for 25 minutes until soft and sweet. Season with 0.5 tsp salt and 0.5 tsp pepper, cool, then mix in the chopped eggs and 2 tbsp chopped dill. Divide the dough into 16, flatten each, fill, pinch closed and set seam side down on lined trays. Rest 15 minutes, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes until golden.
